newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-CFC cut to market perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CFC cut to market perform.

text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it cut its rating on CFC International Inc to market performer from outperformer for both the intermediate term and long term.
Price targets on the stock were cut to $14 from $17 for the intermediate term and to $17 from $22 for the long term.
EVEREN said it also cut its earnings estimate for 1997 to $0.80 a share from $0.98, and for 1998 to $0.95 from $1.18.

The shortfall in earnings, which led to the ratings cut, was based on higher-than-expected start-up costs of a new printing press, lower revenue growth assumptions and less-than-expected profit margin expansion, analyst Shawn Severson said in a report.
EVEREN said, however, CFC's growth prospects are superior to many companies in the same industry.
Shares of CFC, which provides functional coatings for industrial and consumer products, were off 1 at 10-5/8.
